chunks: Al-Kulayni and a number of our companions, from Ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami, from Harun ibn al-Jahm, from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:

When death approached al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him), he said to al-Husayn (peace be upon him): 'O my brother, I am bequeathing to you a bequest, so preserve it. When I die, prepare me, then direct me toward the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) so that I may renew my covenant with him. Then turn me toward my mother (peace be upon her), then return me and bury me in al-Baqi'. And know that there will befall me from Aisha what God and the people know of her deeds and her enmity toward God and His Messenger, and her enmity toward us, the People of the Household.'

When al-Hasan (peace be upon him) passed away and was placed upon the bier, they carried him to the prayer-place of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) where he used to perform the funeral prayer. Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) performed the prayer over him, and he was carried and brought into the mosque. When he was brought to the grave of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), the one with the little eyes went to Aisha and said to her: 'They have brought al-Hasan to bury him alongside the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).'

She came out hastily upon a saddled mule — and she was the first woman to ride a saddle in Islam — and said: 'Move your son away from my house! He shall not be buried in my house and violate the privacy of the Messenger of God.' Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said to her: 'Long ago, you and your father violated the privacy of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), and brought into his house those whom he did not wish to be near him. And God will question you about that, O Aisha!'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: People of the Household — the Prophet's family, specifically used here for the Imams
key_terms.الْبَقِيع: Al-Baqi' — the cemetery in Medina adjacent to the Prophet's mosque where many Companions and family members are buried
key_terms.حِجَاب: Privacy/sanctity — the sacred boundary protecting the Prophet's household
key_terms.ذُو الْعُوَيْنَيْنِ: The one with the little eyes — a derogatory epithet used here for the spy who informed Aisha
key_terms.وَصِيَّة: Bequest, last will — a formal testamentary instruction from one dying to their heir

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Hasan say to Imam Husayn before his death about his burial?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Imam al-Baqir (AS) through Muhammad ibn Muslim, recounts the last will of Imam Hasan (AS) to his brother Imam Husayn (AS) regarding the burial rites and anticipated opposition from Aisha. It describes the dramatic events following Imam Hasan's death (50 AH), when Aisha rushed out on a saddled mule to prevent his burial near the Prophet's tomb in her house, prompting Imam Husayn's sharp rebuke reminding her of the historic violations committed by her and her father against the Prophet's sanctity and household.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Bakr Bin Salih who said, ‘Al Kulayni and a number of our companions, from Ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman Al Dalaymi, from Haroun Bin Al Jahm, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When the death presented itself to Al-Hassan Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> said to Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> brother<sup>asws</sup>!

I<sup>asws</sup> am bequeathing to you<sup>asws</sup> with a bequest, therefore preserve. When I<sup>asws</sup> pass away, so prepare me<sup>asws</sup>, then divert me<sup>asws</sup> towards Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> so I<sup>asws</sup> renew my<sup>asws</sup> Covenant with him<sup>saww</sup>. Then divert me<sup>asws</sup> towards my<sup>asws</sup> mother<sup>asws</sup>, then return me<sup>asws</sup> and bury me at Al-Baqi’e (Cemetery), and know that there would be difficulties for me<sup>asws</sup> from Ayesha what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the people know of her enmity to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and her enmity towards us<sup>asws</sup>, the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’.

So when Al-Hassanasws passed away and was placed upon the bed, then they went with himasws to the Praying place of Rasool-Allahsaww where hesaww used to Pray Salat in, so Al-Husaynasws prayed Salat over himasws, and heasws was carried and entered into the Masjid. So when heasws was brought to the grave of Rasool-Allahsaww, the two-eyed one (spy) went to Ayesha and he said to her, ‘They have come with Al-Hassanasws in order to bury himasws along with the Prophetsaww’.

So she came out in a rush upon a mule with a saddle. Thus, she was the first woman to have ridden a saddle in Al-Islam. So she said, ‘Move your son away from my house, for he will not be buried in my house and be a violation upon Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> of his<sup>saww</sup> privacy!’ So Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said to her: ‘From a long time you and your father have violated the privacy of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and you entered upon him<sup>saww</sup> in his<sup>saww</sup> house the ones he<sup>saww</sup> did not like, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Ask you about that, O Ayesha!’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Bakr ibn Salih (alKulayni has said) and a number of our people from ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami from Harun ibn al-Jahm from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said that he heard abu Ja‘far (a.s.) say the following.

“When al-Hassan (a.s.) ibn Ali (a.s.) was about to leave this world he said to al-Husayn (a.s.), “O my brother, I want to entrust you with my directive will (please) safeguard and preserve it. When I will die prepare and help me towards (the Shrine of) the Messenger of Allah so I can renew my covenant with him then help me towards my mother (a.s.). Thereafter return me back for burial in Baqi‘ graveyard. You must know that ‘A’isha will create problems for me. Allah and the people know her deeds and her hostile attitude towards Allah and His Messenger and her animosity towards us Ahl al-Bayt (family) of the Holy Prophet.

When al-Hassan (a.s.) passed away his body was placed on the stretcher and then the procession was lead to the place where the Holy Prophet prayed for the dead for burial. Al-Husayn (a.s.) performed the prayer therein and then the body was taken to the Mosque. When (the procession) paused on the grave of the Messenger of Allah Dhul ‘Aynayn (spy) went to ‘A’isha and told her, “They have brought al-Hassan’s body to bury with the Holy Prophet.”

She them came out quickly on the mule with saddle. She was the first woman in the Muslim community to ride on the saddle. She then said, “Take your son away from my house. He will not be buried in my house to disregard the privacy of the Messenger of Allah. Al-Husayn (a.s.) said to her, “A long time ago you and your father had disregarded the privacy of the Messenger of Allah. You brought to his house those whose nearness he did not love. Allah will held you responsible for this O ‘A’isha.”
